sources.title: Günther Hörmann, C*-Algebras with Aspects of Quantum Physics, University of Vienna lecture notes (version of 6 August 2026)
sources.locator: Chapter 6, §§6.1–6.8, PDF pp. 81–92. Read the complete finite and countable CAR constructions, especially §6.1 creation/annihilation and CAR (pp. 81–82), §6.2 one- and two-mode matrices (pp. 82–84), §§6.3–6.5 matrix units and the universal finite/infinite C*-algebra proof (pp. 84–89), and §6.7 Fock irreducibility and representation caveats (pp. 90–92).

§6.4: universal representation norm and generator relations for CAR over a Hilbert space
§6.1 and §6.7: antisymmetric Fock creation and annihilation on Hilbert-space Fock space
§6.4, Properties (ii)–(iii): completion of a pre-Hilbert one-particle space and separability characterization
contents.reason: The assigned pair now constructs CAR(H) for every complex Hilbert space H by a directed limit over its finite-dimensional subspaces. It does not add the separate completion theorem for an arbitrary pre-Hilbert one-particle space or the source’s separability characterization.

contents.name: §6.6: simplicity and Bogoliubov automorphisms of CAR over a general pre-Hilbert space
contents.reason: The assigned bridge needs only countably many fixed modes and the particle-hole automorphism; it does not add simplicity or general Bogoliubov implementation results.

§6.7(ii): uniqueness of the finite-dimensional irreducible CAR representation

§6.7(iii): the stronger uncountability of inequivalent irreducible representations
contents.reason: The approved local claim requires an explicit inequivalent irreducible pair only; this page does not claim or prove the stronger cardinality of the full irreducible-representation space.

contents.name: §6.7(iv)–(vi): regularity, Wick-ordered state determination, and the tracial type-II_1 construction
contents.reason: These state, trace, and von Neumann algebra results are outside the finite CAR/Clifford bridge and countable particle-hole counterexample authorized for this pair.

contents.name: §6.8: tensor products for multiple particle species and fermionic statistics
contents.reason: The assigned mathematical scope makes no multi-species QFT construction and no physical spin-statistics assertion.

sources.locator: §§4.1–4.2, printed pp. 14–17 / PDF pp. 13–16: real CAR as self-adjoint Clifford generators, Pauli/Jordan–Wigner finite models, and Theorem 10 finite representation structure; §5.7, printed pp. 22–23 / PDF pp. 21–22: creation/annihilation on symmetric and antisymmetric Fock spaces and Theorem 17 CAR. The notes use {phi_i,phi_j}=2 delta_ij; the local proof explicitly translates to the complex a_i,a_i* convention.
